title: Execution of the input-copy machine
statement: Let $x$ be a word over an arbitrary alphabet, choose a work tape $i$ among $k$ tapes, and let $d$ be a configuration on input $x$ whose state is the forward-scan state and whose input head is at position $1$. After $2|x|+2$ steps, the input-copy machine is in its done state, and tape $i$ contains a copy of $x$ in the cells from the initial head position through the next $|x|-1$ cells, while all other tape cells retain their contents; before that time it is never in the done state. At every time up to and including $2|x|+2$, the head on tape $i$ lies between one cell left of its initial position and $|x|$ cells to its right, inclusive, and every other tape head remains at its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: A symbol alphabet and a word $x$ over it
A natural number $k$ of work tapes
The initial state of $d$ is the forward-scan state
The input head of $d$ is at position $1$
